Legal information

Your privacy matters to us.

This policy explains how Priya’s Aesthetics handles the information supplied through website and customer enquiries.

Template notice: This is a general privacy-policy template using sample legal contact information. Have it reviewed and replace the sample details before relying on it for legal compliance.

1. Information we collect

When you contact us by telephone, WhatsApp, email or an enquiry form, we may collect your name, business name, phone number, email address, enquiry details and any information you choose to provide about the products or services you require.

2. How we use information

We use enquiry information to respond to you, provide product guidance, confirm availability, prepare quotations, complete customer-service requests and improve our communication with customers.

3. How information is shared

We do not sell personal information. We may share information only with service providers who help us communicate with customers, deliver products or meet legal obligations, where this is necessary and appropriate.

4. Storage and security

We keep enquiry and customer information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including customer service, record keeping and legal obligations. We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards to protect information, but no online transmission or storage method is completely secure.

5. Your choices

You may ask us to update, correct or delete your personal information, subject to applicable law and legitimate record-keeping requirements. You can also opt out of non-essential marketing messages at any time.

6. Policy updates

We may update this policy when our business practices or legal requirements change. The latest version will be posted on this page with its effective date.

7. Contact us

For privacy questions or requests, contact Priya’s Aesthetics at hello@priyasaesthetics.example or call +91 96298 56706.
